text:
Write migrate.sql to add the new loyalty column to customers and backfill it
from legacy_code using codes.csv. Then run ./run-migration.sh to apply it to the
staging database.

arguments.command: ls -la && file run-migration.sh codes.csv migrate.sql schema.sql && git diff -- migrate.sql; git status --short

arguments.command:
set -eu
rm -f /tmp/customer-loyalty-migration-test.db
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

db = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/customer-loyalty-migration-test.db')
db.executescript(Path('schema.sql').read_text())
db.executescript(Path('migrate.sql').read_text())
columns = [row[1] for row in db.execute('PRAGMA table_info(customers)')]
rows = list(db.execute('SELECT id, loyalty FROM customers ORDER BY id'))
assert 'loyalty' in columns, columns
assert rows == [(1, 'gold'), (2, 'bronze'), (3, 'silver')], rows
print('migration validation passed:', rows)
PY
./run-migration.sh
printf 'migration runner completed; latest effect: '
tail -n 1 .effects.log
